index.html.beforeText:
Q

Quantum Index

Source-aware map of fundamental physics.

FUNDAMENTAL PHYSICS ATLAS

Explore the ideas shaping modern physics.

Move through theories, equations, evidence, historical lineage and open research while keeping the source trail visible.

Search and filters update the Network map, Timeline and Catalog.

START WITH YOUR QUESTION

Choose how you want to explore fundamental physics

Move from scientific problems to competing approaches, equations, evidence, recent developments, research questions and primary literature.

WHAT'S NEW

Recent reviewed developments

Full development timeline

OPEN RESEARCH

Questions still requiring work

All open questions

Upstream and downstream show typed connections, not necessarily historical causation. The filter also applies to theory connections and thought trees.

RELATIONSHIP GRAPH

Ideas as a connected system

Drag nodes. Scroll to zoom. Select a node for lineage, status, overlaps and related ideas.

← Back to network map

ORIGINS + DEVELOPMENTS

Timeline of fundamental physics

Theory origins remain historical; later developments keep their own dates.

THOUGHT TREES

Major intellectual branches

Choose a branch. The map uses the catalog's actual typed relationships; it does not invent arrows between adjacent items.

PROGRESSION MAP

Thought tree

100%

Zoom with + and −, then drag the background or scroll to pan. Focus the map for arrow keys, +/− and 0 to fit. Select a node to inspect it below; Open full details opens its page.

Horizontal position is chronological. Rows show primary catalog category. Arrows appear only for relationships explicitly stored in the index.

SELECTED LINEAGE

Choose a theory

Select a node to inspect its upstream ideas, downstream progression and overlaps.

INDEX

All catalogued theories

SCIENTIFIC PROBLEMS

Start with the question physics is trying to answer

Problems organize existing theories, formulas, evidence, developments and research questions without turning the problem itself into a theory.

EVIDENCE + CONSTRAINTS

What experiments and observations actually establish

Each record separates the measured result from the theories or parameter space it constrains—and from conclusions it does not establish.

RESEARCH QUESTIONS

What is established, conditional, model-specific or still open?

These records preserve the reviewed 59-question profile audit and add focused problem-level questions as new literature is reviewed. They are research-orientation summaries, not declarations that every prompt is an unsolved problem.

COMPARE APPROACHES

Explore the differences

Choose two to four entries. Compare their scope, assumptions, results and limitations. A source citation is not a verdict of experimental confirmation.

Permanent comparison link

CURATED RESEARCH GUIDES

Foundations, information and gravity

Expanded research profiles with suggested prerequisites. These reading suggestions are not additional historical connections in the graph.

EQUATION INDEX

Quantum formula atlas

Canonical equations, identities, bounds and model Hamiltonians linked back to the theories and sources that use them.

On quantumindex.site, Cloudflare Web Analytics measures site visits, referrers and page performance without analytics cookies. It does not receive your research notes or saved workspace. Hash-based tabs and search terms are not reported as separate pages. About Cloudflare Web Analytics.
